description: Flat metadata schema for records describing iPSC lines derived from skin fibroblasts and differentiated into cardiomyocytes, including provenance, reprogramming, culture conditions, genetic modifications, and differentiation/function outcomes.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the metadata record or iPSC line/differentiation experiment instance.

donor_id.descr: Unique identifier for the human donor from whom the skin fibroblasts were obtained.

donor_age_years.descr: Age of the donor at fibroblast collection, in years.

donor_sex.descr: Biological sex of the donor; acceptable values include male, female, intersex, or unknown.

donor_ethnicity.descr: Self-reported or inferred donor ancestry/ethnicity, if available.

source_cell_type.descr: Starting somatic cell type used for reprogramming; for this dataset typically skin fibroblast.

source_tissue.descr: Primary tissue source of the somatic cells; for example skin or dermis.

cell_line_name.descr: Name or label of the iPSC line.

cell_line_clone_id.descr: Identifier for the specific clone, if multiple clones were derived from the same donor.

reprogramming_method.descr: Method used to generate iPSCs, such as Sendai virus, episomal plasmids, mRNA, retroviral, or lentiviral delivery.

reprogramming_factors.descr: Reprogramming factor cocktail used to induce pluripotency; commonly OCT4, SOX2, KLF4, and c-MYC.

reprogramming_efficiency_pct.descr: Efficiency of iPSC reprogramming expressed as a percentage of starting cells that yielded iPSC colonies.

reprogramming_duration_days.descr: Number of days from factor delivery to colony selection or established iPSC generation.

pluripotency_validation_method.descr: Assay used to confirm pluripotency, such as marker staining, qPCR, embryoid body formation, or teratoma assay.

pluripotency_markers_detected.descr: List or summary of pluripotency markers detected, such as OCT4, NANOG, SOX2, SSEA4, TRA-1-60.

genetic_background_description.descr: Text description of the donor or cell line genetic background, including ancestry, disease status, or known variants.

known_genetic_variants.descr: Known pathogenic or informative genetic variants present in the line, if assessed.

karyotype_status.descr: Karyotypic status of the iPSC line, such as normal, abnormal, mosaic, or unknown.

genetic_modification_present.descr: Whether any intentional genetic modification was introduced to the line to enhance cardiomyocyte differentiation.

genetic_modification_type.descr: Type of genetic modification, such as CRISPR knock-in, CRISPR knockout, transgene overexpression, or RNAi.

genetic_modification_target_gene.descr: Gene targeted or introduced by the modification, if applicable.

genetic_modification_description.descr: Free-text description of the introduced genetic modification, including construct or edit details.

epigenetic_modification_present.descr: Whether any epigenetic manipulation was applied, such as chromatin modifier treatment or epigenome editing.

epigenetic_modification_description.descr: Description of epigenetic treatment or modification applied prior to or during differentiation.

passage_number_at_differentiation.descr: Passage number of the iPSC culture at the start of cardiomyocyte differentiation.

culture_substrate.descr: Substrate used for iPSC maintenance or differentiation, such as Matrigel, vitronectin, laminin, or feeder layer.

maintenance_media_composition.descr: Description of the iPSC maintenance medium and key supplements used before differentiation.

differentiation_protocol_name.descr: Name or identifier of the cardiomyocyte differentiation protocol used.

differentiation_media_composition.descr: Description of the media composition used during cardiomyocyte differentiation, including key signaling modulators.

differentiation_start_day.descr: Day relative to differentiation initiation when the protocol began, typically 0.

differentiation_end_day.descr: Day relative to differentiation initiation when the differentiation endpoint was assessed.

cardiomyocyte_purity_pct.descr: Percentage of cells classified as cardiomyocytes at the time of assessment, based on marker expression or other assay.

differentiation_efficiency_pct.descr: Overall efficiency of differentiation from iPSC to cardiomyocyte, expressed as a percentage.

cardiomyocyte_marker_positive.descr: Whether cardiomyocyte marker expression was detected, such as TNNT2, MYH6, or ACTN2.

cardiomyocyte_markers_assayed.descr: Markers assayed for cardiomyocyte identification, such as TNNT2, NKX2-5, MYL2, or cTnT.

beating_observed.descr: Whether spontaneous beating was observed in the differentiated cardiomyocytes.

beating_onset_day.descr: Day post-differentiation when spontaneous beating first appeared, if observed.

contractility_assay_method.descr: Method used to quantify contractile function, such as video microscopy, impedance, traction force, or calcium imaging.

contractility_measurement_value.descr: Quantitative contractility readout, with units determined by the assay (for example beats per minute, force in microNewtons, or relative units).

electrophysiology_assay_method.descr: Method used to assess electrophysiological function, such as patch clamp, multielectrode array, or voltage-sensitive dye imaging.

action_potential_duration_ms.descr: Action potential duration measured in milliseconds, if assessed.

field_potential_duration_ms.descr: Field potential duration measured in milliseconds, if assessed.

calcium_transient_amplitude.descr: Amplitude of calcium transients, reported in assay-specific units or normalized fluorescence units.

calcium_transient_frequency_hz.descr: Frequency of calcium transients, in Hertz.

arrhythmia_observed.descr: Whether arrhythmic or irregular beating behavior was observed.

stress_condition_applied.descr: Whether a stress challenge or disease-relevant perturbation was applied during maturation or functional testing.

stress_condition_description.descr: Description of any applied stress condition, such as hypoxia, beta-adrenergic stimulation, or drug exposure.

batch_id.descr: Identifier for the experimental batch or differentiation run.

operator_id.descr: Identifier for the person or facility responsible for the experiment, if tracked.

assay_date.descr: Date on which the differentiation or functional assay was performed.

qc_passed.descr: Whether the record passed quality-control criteria for inclusion in downstream analysis.

qc_notes.descr: Free-text notes on quality control, exclusions, contamination, or protocol deviations.

omics_data_available.descr: Whether transcriptomic, epigenomic, proteomic, or other omics data are available for this record.

gene_expression_signature.descr: Text or identifier for the gene expression signature associated with the line or differentiation outcome, if available.

epigenetic_marker_signature.descr: Text or identifier for measured epigenetic markers associated with differentiation success, if available.
